text:
Maya: Quick mock for legend densification — group series by unit with a tiny unit badge and a 4-bin mini-hist. Hover expands details. Screenshot: <link>
Owen: Nice. Keep legend rows <=2 lines. Unit badge should be muted and right-aligned so the name truncates cleanly.
Sam: A11y: make each mini-hist keyboard-focusable. On focus announce: 'p50 120 ms, p95 480 ms'. Use aria-describedby to reference the stats.
Priya: Outlier handling: default = chevrons at top/bottom that indicate values exceed view. Clicking toggles expanded scale. Less surprising than auto-rescale.
Maya: Also add optional "soft-compress" in chart settings (nonlinear transform) with a subtle 'nonlinear' pill when enabled and a tooltip: 'preserves order, compresses extremes'.
Owen: Smoothing default OFF on dashboards. Provide a banner: 'Smoothing available for trend reading' with a Preview button that overlays the smoothed series.
Sam: Implementation note: mini-hists should be generated server-side as 4 bins (avoid per-point DOM). Send bins in the chart payload.
Priya: Copy tweak: legend entry shows 'requests  rps' (unit muted). If unit unknown show '?' badge and inspector explains inference.
Maya: CSS snippet for focus reveal:
```
.legend-item:focus .inspector { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
```
Owen: Telemetry: emit chart.outlier_mode_change and chart.unit_toggle. Default outlier_mode = 'chevron'.
DesignBot: Release note: default behaviors: uniform Y = off for detail views, on for small-multiples dashboard template; outlier mode = chevron; smoothing = off.
Maya: I'll prototype in Storybook tomorrow 10am. Owen/Sam — can you pair on a11y and bins?
Owen: Yep. Sam: I'll handle the a11y checklist. Priya: I'll write the microcopy for the chevron state.
Maya: Thanks all. Leaving final sign-off to Maya + Owen.
